global: Skin must show real pores and natural unevenness everywhere - never smooth, waxy or airbrushed, even in small areas.
Never render a patterned fabric as plain or smoothed-out; pattern keeps its exact scale, density and placement.
Never invent trims, lace edges, pockets, embroidery or straps that are absent from the reference photos.
Backgrounds must read as real photographed places with lived-in wear - never painterly, CGI-clean or theatrical.
No grain, noise or speckling anywhere; detail must stay crisp - imperfection never means blur.
Poses stay elegant and composed - never hunched, sickly or awkward.
Vary color worlds between images - never let everything drift into the same yellow-beige tones.
